I’ve been going to this pizzeria since I moved here 11 years ago, and for most of that time, I genuinely loved it. The old family who owned it provided great service, were friendly, and the pizza was always amazing.

Unfortunately, since the business was sold, my experience has been completely different. From the moment we walked in, the new owner just wasn’t friendly. I smiled and tried to greet him when we first came in, and he barely acknowledged us and just had a straight face. I understand that everyone has their own personality, but as a customer, you expect at least a little friendliness and basic customer service.

I ordered four pizzas, and honestly, they were extremely oily and pretty mediocre, especially considering how expensive they are. I also ended up getting a huge stomach ache afterward, which made the experience even worse.

The part that really bothered me, though, was what happened with the tables. This happened twice during our visit. The first time, I sat in a chair closer to the bathroom because I was waiting for it to become available. I didn’t want to keep walking back and forth from our table, and the restaurant wasn’t even busy. While I was sitting there, he came over and started wiping down the table even though it wasn’t dirty and I was still sitting there.

Then, later, my boyfriend and I were sitting at our actual table talking. We were getting ready to leave, and I was only waiting because I wanted to use the bathroom before we left, but it was still occupied. While we were still sitting there and having a conversation, he came over AGAIN and started wiping down our table while we were right there. The table wasn’t dirty, and we weren’t done yet. After that, we decided to just leave instead of waiting around.

I’ve been coming here for 11 years, so it honestly makes me sad to have such a different experience now. I have so many good memories of this place under the previous owners, but between the unfriendly service, the way the tables were handled, the quality of the food, and how sick it made me feel afterward, I unfortunately won’t be coming back.

Edit: I’d also like to add that there was a Caucasian woman sitting outside who had already been there before we arrived and had completely finished her meal, but he never went over and wiped down her table. He also didn’t wipe down the table where some white college students were sitting near the front inside. So seeing him come over to our table twice while we were still sitting there, when the table wasn’t even dirty, honestly made us feel singled out.

If you’re looking to be ignored when you walk in, not greeted, spoken to rudely, and treated like you’re an inconvenience, then this is the place for you. Basic courtesy, professionalism, and customer service seem to be completely absent. The staff consistently came across as unfriendly, dismissive, rude, and unwelcoming, with attitudes that made the entire experience uncomfortable. Loyal customers are what keep local businesses alive, and treating people this way is not a recipe for long-term success.

Overall, I’d rate this business 2 out of 10.

review_text:
$60 sourdough loaf is already a bad joke, however, I would have spent that as an experience if it was really outstanding product. Unfortunately too far from it.
Bread itself was visually pretty and tasted fine. Not quite feeling like a sourdough, due to somewhat dense and chewy texture but the rye flavor was round and pleasant without being excessive.
The slices of toasts are disasters. Look pretty but the toppings are not really making anyone feel like having $60 a loaf special baked good. So mundane and lacking character, and even covering the gentle flavors of the bread entirely. They are pretty to eyes but nothing impressive in flavor. Worst of all, the most expensive menu ‘Roe on RYE’ -$14 a slice - has salmon roes cover the slice very pretty, but very fishy. 2 of us had some stomach problems on that evening after sharing it. I really love Ikura on any sushi counter, but this was so far from fresh and one of the worst quality salmon roe I had in years. So bad.
The staffs are very friendly and nice, but then, it started feeling like mismatch that such nice and elaborate explanations are for such disappointing products.
No way to revisit, and would never  recommend.
